dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, linear 2D narrowing from the wide midsection toward a sharp posterior point at the peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Uniform lateral margins with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations; the interface between the skin and water appears smooth.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface with no significant slate-grey coverage.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; two isolated clusters of dark-pixel stippling located on the central and posterior dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; the dark-pixel clusters exhibit a stippled, speckled gradient rather than sharp edge boundaries.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Two distinct stippled grey patches on the dorsal midline and several faint, longitudinal linear streaks on the lower dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible stippled pigmented patches on the dorsal ridge and faint healed linear marks on the posterior half of the visible body.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, sharply defined dorsal ridge and a clearly visible, open blowhole at the anterior terminus.
